## Use flask to create the website #
### Requirements #
  - [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) (it installs the pinned Python and dependencies)

## To freeze the website to docs directory #
  - `make`
    * It will generate the static website into `docs/`
    * `docs/` is served by GitHub Pages (deploy from branch `main`, folder `/docs`)
    * Files in `docs/` not generated by flask (CNAME, cs111b_fall2017, ...) are kept

## To run a local dev server #
  - `make debug`, then open http://localhost:5000
